Commentary.Commentary: The Indian bowlers shattered through the English gates in phases and all of them combined to get them out quick. It was more like they hunted the batsmen down like a wolf pack together. India will have to chase down a target of 103 runs to win the 3rd Test and take a lead of 2-0 in the 5 match series. Stay tuned as the chase is just round the corner.

Root and Buttler were batting well till the latter threw it away with a rash shot. Root got his half century but could not carry on for long and was dismissed by a fantastic catch in the slips by Rahane. Hameed who came in late due to his injury kept fighting till he could as he ran out of partners. Woakes and Rashid got shattered by some tremendous body line stuff by Shami with the new ball. Anderson stuck up for some time but he was run out by a brilliant fielding effort by Jadeja. Hameed stayed not out with a very brilliant knock of 59.

So that ends England's effort with the bat for this Test! They started up with some really good batting yesterday at the start till Ashwin shattered through the defense of Cook, they looked shaky after that as they lost three quick wickets till the end of the day. Batty came in as the nightwatchman who was sent back packing in the first over he faced today.

Root had got good support by Hameed who came out to bat lower down the order. They kept the Indian bowlers at bay who were relentless all the while. Ashwin was called on for a bowl only in the second hour and the bowling changes were spot on by the Indian skipper. They will look to wrap things up early and ensure there are no lower order heroics from England. Join us in a while for the second session of play.

Game time! JOE ROOT and GARETH BATTY are out in the middle. How will they approach the game today? Will they go for the attack or shut shop to bat time as well? They have a tough task on hand. India begin with UMESH YADAV. A wide slip in place for him. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain reckons the cold weather has helped in holding the wicket together. Sunil Gavaskar adds that some balls have turned and that has not helped England. Mentions that the cracks are opening up outside the off stump for the left-handed batsman at one end. Opines that he would get as close to the ball as possible and smother the turn.

Seems like the match is a far cry from the England perspective as they have a deficit of 56 runs and have already lost 4 wickets. Root and Buttler are the batsmen who could make the match a bit more interesting with Hameed to follow. They will have to practically have a very good game out there to make life tough for the Indians who are having a merry time out on the field.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 4 of the third Test between India and England at the Punjab Cricket Association Stadium, Mohali. It's been a mixed Test match for England as whenever they were looking to get on top, the purple patch was disrupted by the all-rounders who have been the guys to watch out for in this match.
DAY 4... SESSION 1...

So England have a tough task ahead. They'll need their lower middle order to save this Test as they are starring down the barrel. Let's see how the visitors fight back tomorrow. Join us back for the day 4 action then. Goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Alastair Cook was quite lucky early on but Ravichandran Ashwin got the better of him and sent him back to the dressing room. Moeen Ali didn't survive for a long time and gave away his wicket to Ashwin as well. Jayant Yadav then removed the in-form Jonny Bairstow and Ben Stokes got out to Ashwin towards the end. Joe Root, who came in as an opener has battled it out so far and he's unbeaten on 36.

India are well on top here after stumps on day 3! Brilliant cricket by the hosts as England are still trailing by 56 runs and have already lost four crucial wickets. Earlier, India's lower order took them past the 400-run mark. Handy knocks by Ashwin, Jadeja and Jayant Yadav gave India a crucial 134-run lead.
